title.fr: PDSS — Échelle de gravité du trouble panique (auto-rapport)
title.pt: PDSS — Escala de gravidade do transtorno de pânico (auto-relato)

subtitle.ru: Выраженность панических симптомов за последнюю неделю.
subtitle.en: Panic symptom severity over the past week.
subtitle.fr: Gravité des symptômes paniques sur la semaine passée.
subtitle.de: Schwere panischer Symptome in der letzten Woche.
subtitle.pt: Gravidade dos sintomas de pânico na última semana.

description.ru: Краткая оценка, насколько панические симптомы мешают жизни: частота приступов, переживание, ожидание новых, избегание и снижение функционирования. Не заменяет диагноз. Оригинальная методика (Shear et al.) охраняется авторским правом; для публикаций и распространения может требоваться разрешение правообладателя.
description.en: A brief look at how panic symptoms affect you—attacks, distress, worry about more, avoidance, and day-to-day functioning. Not a diagnosis. The original PDSS is copyrighted (Shear et al.); permission may be required for some uses.
description.fr: Bref aperçu de l’impact des symptômes paniques (attaques, détresse, anticipation, évitement, fonctionnement). Pas un diagnostic. PDSS protégé.
description.de: Kurze Einschätzung der Belastung durch Panik (Anfälle, Distanz, Vermeidung, Alltag). Keine Diagnose. PDSS urheberrechtlich geschützt.
description.pt: Visão breve do impacto dos sintomas de pânico. Não é diagnóstico. PDSS com direitos autorais.

instructions.ru: Ответьте по состоянию за последние семь дней. Для первого пункта укажите число приступов по предложенной градации; для остальных — степень выраженности.
instructions.en: Answer for the past seven days. For item 1, use the frequency scale; for the others, rate how much each problem applied to you.
instructions.fr: Répondez pour les sept derniers jours. Item 1 : fréquence ; autres items : intensité.
instructions.de: Beantworten Sie für die letzten sieben Tage. Item 1: Häufigkeit; übrige Items: Ausprägung.
instructions.pt: Responda pelos últimos sete dias. Item 1: frequência; demais itens: intensidade.

description.ru: Симптомы в этой зоне часто описывают как менее выраженные; как это переживаете вы, зависит от контекста.
description.en: Symptoms in this band are often described as less intense; your own experience still depends on context.
description.fr: Symptômes souvent moins intenses dans cette zone ; le vécu reste personnel.
description.de: Symptome in dieser Zone oft als geringer beschrieben; Ihr Erleben hängt vom Kontext ab.
description.pt: Sintomas nesta faixa costumam ser descritos como menos intensos; o vivido depende do contexto.

description.ru: Умеренно выраженные симптомы; имеет смысл обсудить с врачом или психотерапевтом.
description.en: Moderately strong symptoms; consider discussing with a physician or therapist.
description.fr: Symptômes modérément marqués ; un suivi professionnel peut aider.
description.de: Mäßig ausgeprägte Symptome; Abklärung bei Fachperson sinnvoll.
description.pt: Sintomas moderadamente intensos; considere conversar com profissional.

description.ru: Сильное влияние симптомов на жизнь; рекомендуется обращение к специалисту.
description.en: Strong impact of symptoms on daily life; seek professional assessment.
description.fr: Impact fort sur la vie quotidienne ; évaluation professionnelle recommandée.
description.pt: Impacto forte no dia a dia; avaliação profissional recomendada.

text.ru: Сколько за последнюю неделю у вас было полноценных панических атак (или приступов с почти полным набором симптомов)?
text.en: How many full panic attacks (or attacks with almost a full set of symptoms) did you have during the past week?
text.fr: How many full panic attacks (or attacks with almost a full set of symptoms) did you have during the past week?
text.de: How many full panic attacks (or attacks with almost a full set of symptoms) did you have during the past week?
text.pt: How many full panic attacks (or attacks with almost a full set of symptoms) did you have during the past week?

text.ru: Если приступы были, насколько они были для вас мучительными?
text.en: If you had attacks, how distressing were they for you?
text.fr: If you had attacks, how distressing were they for you?
text.de: If you had attacks, how distressing were they for you?
text.pt: If you had attacks, how distressing were they for you?

text.ru: Насколько за неделю вас беспокоили ожидание новых приступов и связанные с этим страхи?
text.en: During the past week, how much were you bothered by anticipating attacks and related fears?
text.fr: During the past week, how much were you bothered by anticipating attacks and related fears?
text.de: During the past week, how much were you bothered by anticipating attacks and related fears?
text.pt: During the past week, how much were you bothered by anticipating attacks and related fears?

text.ru: Насколько за неделю вы избегали ситуаций, где мог бы случиться приступ (агорафобическое избегание)?
text.en: During the past week, how much did you avoid situations where panic might occur?
text.fr: During the past week, how much did you avoid situations where panic might occur?
text.de: During the past week, how much did you avoid situations where panic might occur?
text.pt: During the past week, how much did you avoid situations where panic might occur?

text.ru: Насколько за неделю вы избегали действий, вызывающих телесные ощущения, похожие на панику (нагрузка, жару и т.п.)?
text.en: During the past week, how much did you avoid activities that trigger bodily sensations similar to panic?
text.fr: During the past week, how much did you avoid activities that trigger bodily sensations similar to panic?
text.de: During the past week, how much did you avoid activities that trigger bodily sensations similar to panic?
text.pt: During the past week, how much did you avoid activities that trigger bodily sensations similar to panic?

text.ru: Насколько симптомы паники мешали работе или домашним обязанностям за неделю?
text.en: How much did panic symptoms interfere with work or home responsibilities this past week?
text.fr: How much did panic symptoms interfere with work or home responsibilities this past week?
text.de: How much did panic symptoms interfere with work or home responsibilities this past week?
text.pt: How much did panic symptoms interfere with work or home responsibilities this past week?

text.ru: Насколько симптомы паники мешали общению и социальной жизни за неделю?
text.en: How much did panic symptoms interfere with your social life this past week?
text.fr: How much did panic symptoms interfere with your social life this past week?
text.de: How much did panic symptoms interfere with your social life this past week?
text.pt: How much did panic symptoms interfere with your social life this past week?
